legend.0: Routine: a maintenance release, bug fix, translation update, dependency bump or security patch. Nothing for the user to do beyond installing it and restarting Home Assistant.
legend.1: Feature: adds something user-visible, or changes a default, while every existing setup keeps working unchanged.
legend.2: Possibly breaking: removes or renames something, requires a migration, or needs a manual step after installing. Restarting Home Assistant after installing is not a manual step: it is normal for every update.
